title: The Danger of Power Without Principle
text: [Music] delivered people do not need freedom they need training i'm going to say this again god has shown that delivered people do not need freedom they need training first delivered people should not be given power they need to be given principles to live by if you give a delivered person power you're in trouble my friends in africa watching this program you know it's true when you give people who ain't free but just delivered power the delivered people are in trouble because anytime a man doesn't have principles he's going to use the power to oppress his own delivered people i will never forget a statement i read in our newspaper a few years ago during a few elections back i'll never forget that statement long as i live i say oh god please don't ever let this nation come to that someone asked someone to stand up for a particular principle i don't know who was i don't know what to say but i read this statement and and this leader said don't talk to me about principles let me tell you something when principles are no longer important you are dangerous because the only thing that can protect me from you is principles if you got power and no principles then you become a monster because there is no sense of responsibility accountability and compassion delivered people are still slaves in their minds and the bible says woe to a land when a slave becomes king you
